# DSH Studio 0.9.8-plus3

Fixes two issues found in real plus2 usage: the app failing to start after a day
(-1005), and model/session switching wedging after plugin installs.

## Fixed and added

- **The shell server drains the request head** instead of bounding it. dsh plants
  a fresh, randomly-named, thirty-day cookie on 127.0.0.1 at every boot (cookies
  ignore ports); once the accumulated head outgrew the old 4096-byte buffer, the
  server closed the connection mid-request and the app would not start. Only the
  request line is kept now — head size no longer matters.
- **Stale loopback cookies are swept at startup**, before the harness boots, so
  the pile can never outgrow the harness's own 16 KB header limit either.
- **dshmarket's self-restart is disabled** through Studio's integration patch
  (`allowRestart: false`). Its one-click restart spawned a detached process the
  supervisor never parented, stranding one more instance on the same data
  directory per plugin operation — the root cause of wedged model/session
  switching. The market's restart banner now points at a manual restart, which
  Studio owns.

## Verification

- 385 Rust tests pass (including a regression test driving ~130 KB of cookies),
  269 frontend tests pass, clippy `-D warnings` clean.
- Live harness reports `restart.supported: false, managedBy: operator`.
- Reproduced in the field: clearing the accumulated cookies restored startup.

## Installation

Download the installer for your platform below. The macOS build is universal and
ad-hoc signed: right-click the app and choose "Open" on first launch. If Windows
shows a SmartScreen warning, choose "Run anyway".
